adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group.removeMember`, the success handler calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. `findMembers` computes the request offset using the *current* `user_count` (`Math.min(this.get("user_count"), this.get("offset"))`), but after a deletion `user_count` is still the pre-delete value until the fetch returns. If you delete the last user on the last page (e.g., `limit=50`, `offset=50`, `user_count` drops from 51 to 50), the reload request is sent with `offset=50`, and the server (now with only 50 users) returns an empty `members` array, leaving the UI on an empty page instead of stepping back a page.
